description: Ministry of Trade - Cess on Bricks, Blocks, Tiles and other Ceramic Goods of Siliceous fossil meals etc.
categorisation: This gazette content is an order amending the rate of CESS (a tax/levy) under the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. It constitutes a regulatory amendment to existing legislation, which falls under Legal/Regulatory matters. While it mentions a minister's name, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers to modify regulations, not about government personnel changes or portfolio assignments. The core content is about changing tax rates on specific goods, making it a regulatory amendment.
